sqlMap.select: SELECT COLUMN_NAME FROM USER_TAB_COLUMNS A , AR_STA_ITEM B WHERE A.TABLE_NAME = 'AR_HISTORY' AND A.DATA_TYPE = 'NUMBER' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT * FROM PA_DISTINCT_LIST WHERE COLUMN_NAME = FIELD_NAME AND TABLE_NAME = 'PA_HR_V' ) AND A.COLUMN_NAME=B.STA_ITEM_ID ORDER BY B.CAL_ORDER

SELECT COLUMN_NAME, SY_GLOBAL_NAME.CONTENT ITEM_NAME, AR_STA_ITEM_PARAM.CAL_ORDER, GET_ITEM_GLAG(COLUMN_NAME,AR_STA_ITEM_PARAM.CPNY_ID) ITEM_FLAG, GET_ITEM_NUMBER(COLUMN_NAME,AR_STA_ITEM_PARAM.CPNY_ID) ITEM_NUMBER, AR_STA_ITEM.ITEM_NO,STA_ITEM_ID ITEM_ID FROM USER_TAB_COLUMNS, AR_STA_ITEM, AR_STA_ITEM_PARAM, SY_GLOBAL_NAME WHERE TABLE_NAME = #AR_SUMMARY_TABLE# AND DATA_TYPE = 'NUMBER' AND COLUMN_NAME = STA_ITEM_ID AND AR_STA_ITEM.ITEM_NO = AR_STA_ITEM_PARAM.ITEM_NO AND AR_STA_ITEM_PARAM.CPNY_ID = #interCpnyID:VARCHAR# AND AR_STA_ITEM.ITEM_NO = SY_GLOBAL_NAME.NO(+) AND SY_GLOBAL_NAME.LANGUAGE(+) = #interLanguage:VARCHAR# AND AR_STA_ITEM.ACTIVITY = 1 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM PA_DISTINCT_LIST WHERE COLUMN_NAME = DISTINCT_FIELD AND TABLE_NAME = 'PA_HR_V' AND CPNY_ID = #interCpnyID:VARCHAR#) ORDER BY AR_STA_ITEM_PARAM.CAL_ORDER

SELECT COLUMN_NAME, SY_GLOBAL_NAME.CONTENT ITEM_NAME, AR_STA_ITEM_PARAM.CAL_ORDER FROM USER_TAB_COLUMNS, AR_STA_ITEM, AR_STA_ITEM_PARAM, SY_GLOBAL_NAME WHERE TABLE_NAME = #AR_SUMMARY_TABLE# AND DATA_TYPE = 'NUMBER' AND COLUMN_NAME = STA_ITEM_ID AND AR_STA_ITEM.ITEM_NO = AR_STA_ITEM_PARAM.ITEM_NO AND AR_STA_ITEM_PARAM.CPNY_ID = #interCpnyID:VARCHAR# AND AR_STA_ITEM.ITEM_NO = SY_GLOBAL_NAME.NO(+) AND SY_GLOBAL_NAME.LANGUAGE(+) = #interLanguage:VARCHAR# AND AR_STA_ITEM.ACTIVITY = 1 AND AR_STA_ITEM.SHOW_YN = 'Y' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM PA_DISTINCT_LIST WHERE COLUMN_NAME = DISTINCT_FIELD AND TABLE_NAME = 'PA_HR_V' AND CPNY_ID = #interCpnyID:VARCHAR#) and ar_sta_item_param.cpny_id = #interCpnyID:VARCHAR# AND ar_sta_item_param.ORDERNO IS NOT NULL ORDER BY SHOW_ORDER,ar_sta_item_param.ORDERNO

SELECT HR_EMPLOYEE.EMPID, HR_EMPLOYEE.PERSON_ID, HR_EMPLOYEE.LOCAL_NAME, HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME.CONTENT DEPTNAME, AR.AR_MONTH $sqlStatement$ FROM AR_SUMMARY_$interCpnyID$ AR, HR_EMPLOYEE_FOR_CAL HR_EMPLOYEE, HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE AR.PERSON_ID = HR_EMPLOYEE.PERSON_ID AND AR.AR_MONTH = #arMonth:VARCHAR# AND HR_EMPLOYEE.DEPTNO = HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME.DEPTNO(+) AND HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME.LANGUAGE(+) = #interLanguage:VARCHAR#
(SELECT STAT_NO FROM ar_statistic_emptype ASE WHERE ASE.EMP_TYPE_CODE = HR_EMPLOYEE.EMP_TYPE_CODE AND ASE.CPNY_ID = HR_EMPLOYEE.CPNY_ID and rownum=1 ) = #STAT_NO:VARCHAR#
HR_EMPLOYEE.PERSON_ID = #PERSON_ID:VARCHAR#
EXISTS ( SELECT * FROM HR_DEPARTMENT B1 WHERE B1.DEPTNO=HR_EMPLOYEE.DEPTNO START WITH B1.DEPTNO = #deptNO:VARCHAR# CONNECT BY PRIOR B1.DEPTNO = B1.PARENT_DEPT_NO )
HR_EMPLOYEE.EMP_TYPE_CODE = #EmpTypeCodeNo:VARCHAR#
HR_EMPLOYEE.emp_office = #EmpOffice:VARCHAR#
HR_EMPLOYEE.EMP_TYPE_CODE IN (SELECT JOBTYPE_NO FROM HR_JOB_TYPE_SETUP P WHERE JOBTYPE_GROUP_NO = #JobTypeGroupNo# AND CPNY_ID = #interCpnyID:VARCHAR# )
ORDER BY AR.DEPTNO DESC, HR_EMPLOYEE.EMPID
